basic_details.job_title: NIT Rourkela Training & Placement Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: National Institute of Technology Rourkela (राष्ट्रीय प्रौद्योगिकी संस्थान राउरकेला) will engage one Training & Placement Officer on contract at its Career Development Centre (CDC) in Odisha, at a consolidated Rs. 80,000 per month. The essential qualification is a full-time Master's Degree in Engineering/Technology/Science/Management, or a 2-year full-time PGDM-HRM, with 60% marks or 6.00 CGPA throughout the career, plus 2 years of relevant experience. Applications go through a Google Form, and the last date is 29 November 2026, 23:59:59 HRS.

how_to_apply: Submit the duly filled application form in the Google Form at https://forms.gle/3tq3y35ZhCtXifxi7.
Submit the scanned copy of original documents, experience certificates, etc., along with a detailed CV, in the same Google Form.

Incomplete application forms will not be considered for shortlisting. The shortlisting criteria will be as per the Institute's requirements and norms. Applicants should give a correct and active email ID and mobile number, because all correspondence is by email.
Scanned copy of original documents and experience certificates.
No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the employer, for applicants already employed under Central/State Govt./PSU/Autonomous Bodies.
All original documents in support of qualification/experience, at the time of document verification.
important_instructions: Fulfilment of the essential qualifications and experience is required; otherwise the application will be rejected. Applicants already employed under Central/State Govt./PSU/Autonomous Bodies must submit an NOC from the employer at the time of interview. Without it, they will not be allowed to appear and their candidature will not be considered. No TA and DA will be paid for attending the Selection Process. The appointment is not regular employment and gives no claim to the privileges or benefits of regular employment. The Institute may verify antecedents or documents at appointment or during service. If documents are fake or antecedents are suppressed, services are liable to be terminated. If an inadvertent error in selection is found, even after the appointment letter, the Institute reserves the right to modify, withdraw or cancel any communication made to applicants. The decision of the Institute is final in any dispute or ambiguity in selection. No interim enquiry or correspondence will be entertained. Canvassing in any form or any attempt to influence leads to automatic disqualification. For clarification about the application process, contact the Head, CDC at [email protected] or Mob: 9556425605.

content_sections.heading: About the Institute
content_sections.text: National Institute of Technology Rourkela is an institute in Rourkela, Odisha. The post sits in its Career Development Centre, which the notice describes as managing campus recruitment, corporate relations and student skill training. The notice is signed by the Registrar and dated 06/11/2026.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Besides the 2 years of relevant experience, applicants need proven experience in at least one of these areas: Campus placement operations at a reputed Institute or University. Recruitment and talent acquisition within a Corporate House or MNC. Manpower development, corporate training and talent management. Working or having experience in IITs/IIMs/IISERs/NITs/CFTIs. Excellent written and verbal communication skills with high proficiency in English, and strong interpersonal skills to build rapport with students, corporate recruiters, faculties and executives from national and international organizations. Proven competencies in office planning, organizing and team management; strong quantitative and analytical skills with a solid understanding of data analysis and management. Ability to build and maintain strategic relations with public/private sectors and State and National government bodies. Proficiency in maintaining database, Open AI tools, social media, data management and report generation, with updated knowledge of standard computer applications (MS Windows, word processing, spreadsheets, presentations). Experience with ERP portals or similar data management tools that handle campus placements. The notice says "preferably below 45 years as on the last date of application". It adds that persons with higher age and experience may also be considered if found suitable, including recently retired professionals. Age relaxation for categories is not specified in the notice.

rows.details: Master's Degree (full-time) in Engineering/Technology/Science/Management, or 02 years PGDM-HRM (full-time), from a reputed University/Institute with 60% marks or 6.00 CGPA throughout the career

B.E./B.Tech (any branch of Engineering) followed by MBA (full-time) preferably in HRM, or 02 years PGDM-HRM (full-time), from a reputed University/Institute with 60% marks or 6.00 CGPA throughout the career
2 years of relevant experience after the qualifying degree
Preferably below 45 years as on the last date of application

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration during the contract period is Rs. 80,000 per month (consolidated). The notice adds that a higher salary may be offered to a deserving and experienced candidate. The appointment is on a purely temporary basis on yearly renewal for a maximum of 03 years. Renewal is subject to satisfactory annual performance evaluation and the requirement of the Institute. The contract may be terminated with one-month notice from either side. Suitable on-campus family accommodation and Institute medical facilities are provided as per the norms of contractual employment of NIT Rourkela.

content_sections.heading: NIT Rourkela Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Look after the training and placement activities and internship of the students. Oversee the end-to-end placement process, including candidate sourcing, screening, job offers and on boarding. Generate regular reports and analytics to track placement metrics, identify trends and evaluate program effectiveness. Monitor post-placement feedback and promptly address issues or concerns raised by employers or participants. Keep close liaison with industry, Government and non-Government organizations for placement of students. Work with the Coordinators for Industry–Institute Interaction to organize lectures, expert talks and interactive sessions by industry professionals. Guide students for competitive examinations such as TOEFL, GRE, GATE, CAT, etc. Arrange and organize study tours of the students. Accompany and provide facilities, including hospitality, to the HR Team of the companies during campus placement drives. Arrange training programmes for soft skills and interview facing skills using institutional and external expertise. Organize entrepreneurship workshops, hackathons, etc. Create a database on Alumni and their present position. Develop a database on placement records of graduated students and a database of recruiting industries and organizations. Support activity in branding and promotional activities. Willingness to travel occasionally for placement-related meetings, employer visits or recruitment events, and readiness to work in flexible office timing. Any other duties assigned from time to time by Head, CDC or Competent Authorities.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NIT Rourkela Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy, for a Training & Placement Officer on contract at the Career Development Centre.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date is 29/11/2026, 23:59:59 HRS.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Training & Placement Officer post?
faq.answer: A full-time Master's Degree in Engineering/Technology/Science/Management, or a 02-year full-time PGDM-HRM, with 60% marks or 6.00 CGPA throughout the career, plus 2 years of relevant experience after the qualifying degree.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is preferably below 45 years as on the last date of application. Persons with higher age and experience may also be considered if found suitable, including recently retired professionals.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration is Rs. 80,000 per month during the contract period. A higher salary may be offered to a deserving and experienced candidate.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill in the Google Form at https://forms.gle/3tq3y35ZhCtXifxi7. Submit scanned copies of original documents and experience certificates, along with a detailed CV, in the same form.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Applications will be scrutinized, and shortlisted candidates will be called for a personal interaction and documents verification.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely temporary, on yearly renewal for a maximum of 03 years. It gives no claim to the benefits of regular employment.

faq.question: Q9. Do employed candidates need an NOC?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicants already employed under Central/State Govt./PSU/Autonomous Bodies must submit an NOC from their employer at the time of interview, or they will not be allowed to appear.

faq.question: Q10. Will travel allowance be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA and DA will be paid to applicants for attending the Selection Process.
